top_signal.title: Looking for advice from experienced lawn care & snow removal business owners
top_signal.summary: Looking for advice from experienced lawn care and snow removal business owners, especially solo operators.   I have three questions:   PAYMENT OPTIONS   Do you find offering multiple payment options helps attract and retain customers?  —  For lawn care, would you offer weekly/biweekly service with monthly or seasonal payments?  —  For snow removal, would you offer per-push, monthly, or flat seasonal pricing?  —  SOLO OPERATORS & WINTER SCHEDULING   For those running a one-person operation, how do you manage seasonal snow contracts when you have a large number of driveways to service?  —  How do you set realistic arrival-time expectations with customers without losing business because you can’t guarantee a specific time?   FLYERS & DOOR HANGERS   Have flyers and door hangers actually helped you gain customers? Are they worth the investment?  —  I’m willing to spend money on advertising, but my business is currently my only source of income, so I need to be smart about where I invest.  —  I’d appreciate any real-world advice or experiences. Thanks!       submitted by     /u/Interesting-Ad2303       [link]       [comments]
